checks.scope: Wayland, X11, Nix and both Flatpak architectures

checks.scope: Existing config, themes and upstream/fork isolation
checks.evidence: Local Debug and packaged ReleaseFast beta passed test/smoke-cli.sh: fork legacy/current configuration precedence, invalid configuration rejection, upstream configuration isolation, and fork custom-theme lookup despite a same-named upstream theme. Stable/beta/stable shared sample configuration and theme validation also passed. Real existing user profiles remain pending. A copy of the installed Linux profile (currently comments only) validated with both packages, without changing the original; richer native macOS profiles remain pending.

checks.scope: Create, switch, reorder, rename, color, split and transfer tabs
checks.evidence: The stable and packaged beta both passed headless Wayland creation of two quick-terminal tabs and a split, PTY input, switching, hide/show and closing a session while retaining the other. Native macOS lifecycle tests passed. Interactive reorder, rename, colors and transfers remain pending. See beta-evidence/wayland-a41bc3a.json.

checks.scope: Process exit, clipboard prompts and focus on inactive tabs
checks.evidence: On headless Wayland, a process exiting in an inactive split preserved the active tab focus and the remaining session, for both stable and beta. macOS ownership, pending clipboard request and background-exit lifecycle tests also passed in run 41254441921. Native clipboard-prompt interaction remains pending.

checks.scope: Cancel/accept close and quit with hidden and background running sessions
Restore v1/v2/v3 saved state, selected tab, focused split and screen placement
Hotkey, fullscreen, multiple monitors, hide/show, Wayland supported compositor
checks.evidence: Isolated Xvfb tests passed for the beta and installed stable 1.3.2+ghostty2.3: real PTY startup, keyboard input, nonzero resized PTY dimensions, and clean exit. This does not cover visual fidelity, native compositor behavior or hotkeys. Stable and beta also passed the headless Sway quick-terminal tab/split/hide-show comparison. Native hotkeys, fullscreen and monitor behavior remain pending.
